title: Artwork Spec Reader
label: AI project
description: AI document extraction app that reads packaging artwork specification sheets from photos, PDFs and Word files, fills every field, and lets QA teams verify and export them.
about: Artwork Spec Reader turns a photo or scan of a structured document, such as an artwork approval form or spec sheet, into labelled fields and real tables using Google Gemini, with a confidence score on every value. Low-confidence values are flagged so reviewers only check what matters, then save, lock and export the record. Teams define schemas for each document type, and the app reports which fields were found or missing and warns when a document doesn't match. I designed and built it end to end, from frontend and backend to deployment. It is in active development, and there is no public sign-up: demo access is available on request.
responsibilities: Built AI extraction from images, PDFs and Word documents with Google Gemini, including per-field confidence scores.
Designed schema-based verification that reports found and missing fields and flags documents that don't match the expected type.
Created a side-by-side review screen with a zoomable source document next to editable, auto-growing fields.
Added record locking with admin-approved change requests, plus Excel and PDF export using ExcelJS and PDFKit.
Implemented automatic rotation across Gemini models to stay within free-tier daily limits.
Built role-based access (user, admin, developer) with an admin portal for accounts, activity tracking and password resets, and file storage on Amazon S3.
highlights: Google Gemini vision model reads photos, scans, PDFs and Word files into labelled fields and real tables
Per-field confidence scores, with low-confidence values flagged for review
Schema-based verification reports found and missing fields and warns on the wrong document type
Automatic rotation across Gemini models to stay within free-tier daily limits
Files stored on Amazon S3 in production; records export to Excel and PDF

title: Rudra Tarpaulin B2B Website & Admin Panel
description: Client project: SEO-focused B2B catalog site for a Gujarat tarpaulin manufacturer, with a custom admin panel for products, inquiries, content and image uploads.
about: Rudra Enterprise (Rudra Tarpaulin) manufactures HDPE and LDPE tarpaulins, pond liners, truck covers and Silpaulin sheets in Dhanot, Gujarat, and sells in bulk across India. I built their public website and a custom admin panel so the team can run the catalog and handle leads without a developer. The public site is built for search, with keyword-focused titles and descriptions and clear calls to action for WhatsApp and phone inquiries.
responsibilities: Built the public product catalog and company site with Next.js, deployed on Vercel.
Designed a custom admin panel to add, edit and remove products, including specs like GSM and sizes.
Built an inquiry inbox so the client can review quote requests and leads from the site in one place.
Added content editing and image uploads so the team updates banners, text and product photos themselves.
Created Next.js API routes backed by MongoDB for products, inquiries and site content.
Set up SEO metadata for B2B search terms like HDPE tarpaulin manufacturer and wholesale supplier.

title: Honeyvan D2C E-Commerce Platform
description: Founder-built D2C store for my raw honey brand, with online payments, cash on delivery, courier integration and a custom admin panel for inventory, orders and content.
about: Honeyvan is my own raw honey brand (Green Earth Enterprise), and honeyvan.in is its direct-to-consumer store, which I built and maintain end-to-end, from architecture to deployment. Customers pay online or choose cash on delivery, orders flow into parcel and courier fulfillment, and a custom admin panel runs inventory, orders and content. Alongside the engineering, I own the brand's SEO, social media, FSSAI/GST compliance and product labeling.
responsibilities: Built and maintain honeyvan.in end-to-end, from architecture to deployment.
Integrated an online payment gateway, a cash-on-delivery order flow, and parcel/courier services for fulfillment.
Designed a custom admin panel for inventory, order and content management, with ongoing feature customization.
Built a Telegram notification bot that pushes checkout inquiries and customer support chats to the admin instantly.
Own the brand's SEO strategy and social media presence.

title: StrangerConnect Video Matching App
description: Real-time anonymous video chat platform with active queue matchmaking, low-latency WebRTC streams, and token-based security.
about: StrangerConnect is a real-time chat platform that anonymously connects random users over video and text streams. Includes security-first authentication, multi-level active queue matchmaking, and optimized grid layouts.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented the front-end user matching state machine using React hooks and Socket.io events.
Integrated WebRTC peer connections with fallback STUN/TURN configurations for high-reliability video chat.
Implemented JWT refresh token authentication and role-based permissions to ensure platform safety.

title: BLE & UART Monitoring Apps
description: Cross-platform Electron + React ECG apps with BLE/UART device communication, real-time waveforms and MQTT cloud upload, deployed in live hospital environments.
about: Cross-platform ECG desktop applications for Windows, macOS and Linux that connect to ECG hardware over BLE and UART for Resting, Holter and TMT workflows, render waveforms in real time, and upload recordings to the cloud. Deployed in live hospital environments.
responsibilities: Implemented BLE and UART device communication for Resting, Holter and TMT ECG workflows, with multi-device connectivity.
Built real-time waveform visualization and session management with Chart.js overlays for signal and lead health.

Supported production deployments in live hospital environments with direct on-call issue resolution.
